Key facts
Mintage: 100,000 — the lowest business-strike Morgan.
Valuable even heavily worn; gem examples are six- to seven-figure coins.
Frequently counterfeited or altered (added-S, date alteration) — buy certified.
Composition: 90% silver, ≈0.7734 oz.
